theme: Christmas arrives, angels stay, dances go duo
src: Source: TikTok and Instagram sound pages, Postdom and SocialPilot, checked 5 Nov 2026.
glance_title: Christmas replaced Halloween, and 14 of 19 trends are new
glance_note: Eleven trends left the list, including the Halloween sounds. The biggest evergreen trend, the Ba Ba Ba dance, sits at 714.6K TikTok videos.
story_title: The Christmas switch happened on 1 November, right on time
story_bullets: Mariah Carey's song came back on 1 Nov, as it has each year since at least 2023
Santa Tell Me and Underneath the Tree joined it, and November Rain runs to the end of the month
The 16.2M video count covers every year, so it does not measure this season
Australian brands should swap snow for heat, beach or backyard

moments.head: A dad and daughter took over Ba Ba Ba
moments.text: Their 27 Oct post is the biggest on the sound: 22.1M views and 3.9M likes.

moments.head: JADE joined the trend
moments.text: JADE's 20 Oct TikTok about Kylie Jenner's runway walk reached 23.7M plays.
moments.trend: Not every angel walks the runway

moments.head: A 2020 slow-mo sound came back
moments.text: Pray For Me grew 40% since 20 Oct, from 34.4K to 48.2K videos.

moments.head: Tate McRae's Housewife became a POV
moments.text: 503.1K videos pair a busy-day POV line with a strut to the chorus.

tbl1: Six trends lead the list, each above 450K videos
tbl2: Angels are rising, and small sounds are worth a look
tbl3: Four date-bound trends end by Christmas

Ba Ba Ba dance.ctx: Easy duo dance under a 'how long have you been friends?' caption

Vlog timestamps.ctx: Clips of a day or job, each labelled with a time or step

Someone's gotta hold it down.ctx: The place that keeps running while everyone else is away

Housewife POV.ctx: POV line about an ordinary day, then a strut to the chorus

Preparing for my Netflix documentary.name: My Netflix documentary
Preparing for my Netflix documentary.ctx: Mime a lapel mic and frame a petty event as a documentary

Not every angel walks the runway.ctx: You at your desk or commute, walking like an angel anyway

Money can't buy happiness, but....ctx: The caption sets it up, then a clip of what makes you happy

Upside Down hand transition.ctx: Mouth the lyric, hit the gesture, cut to the reveal

The Process (process to result).name: The Process

All I Want for Christmas Is You, the Nov.ctx: Marks the move from Halloween to Christmas. Runs to 25 Dec

November Rain.ctx: Moody clips and 90s memory montages. Runs to 30 Nov

Santa Tell Me countdown.ctx: Countdown clips, gift ideas and unboxings. Runs to 25 Dec

Underneath the Tree reveals.ctx: Tree reveals and decor going up. Runs to 25 Dec

Beautiful people are busy.ctx: Lip-sync the line, then walk away from the camera

lang_title: Mogging and maxxing climb while most slang cools
case_title: How a 2024 single became the office worker's runway
case_trend: Not every angel walks the runway
case_steps: JADE releases Angel Of My Dreams as a single
The song plays during Kylie Jenner's Victoria's Secret show walk
JADE's TikTok reaches 23.7M plays. @kelsey_paul posts 'I'm in Excel'
@australia uses the dreamy version for a Melbourne reel
brand_title: The workplace joke suits any team, but it will date quickly
brand_label: Instagram reels on the audio by 5 Nov, up from 241K on 2 Nov
brand_use: 'Not every angel walks the runway, some of us do the BAS.' Hotels can use the dreamy version: their best view, or a ring box opening.
brand_risk: It is a major-label track, so business accounts may be blocked. The joke leans on one celebrity moment, so it will age faster than the dreamy version.
peak_title: Nine of 19 trends are peaking, and four are still climbing
story_trends: All I Want for Christmas Is You, the November 1 switch
